title: MessagingDeliveryError - Data API
description: Represents a log of triggered outbound failures to verify when a triggered outbound has failed. This object is available in API version 44.0 and later.

CreatedById.description: ID of the user who created the error.

DestinationPhoneNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DestinationPhoneNumber.description: The recipient of the phone call.

FailureReason.description: The provided reason for why the message failed.

FlowEntity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
FlowEntity.description: The entity that triggered the flow to send the message.

Id.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort

IsDeleted.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the error has been deleted.

LastModifiedById.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
LastModifiedById.description: The ID of the user who last modified the error log.

LastModifiedDate.description: Date when the Messaging error log was last modified.

MessagingChannelId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MessagingChannelId.description: ID of the MessagingChannel. This is a relationship field.

MessagingEndUserId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MessagingEndUserId.description: Identifier for the Messaging user. This is a relationship field.

MessagingTemplateId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
MessagingTemplateId.description: ID of the Messaging template used. This is a relationship field.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Namefield, Sort
Name.description: Name of the error. Maximum length is 80 characters.

SystemModstamp.description: System modification time for the Messaging delivery error log.

Type.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: The kind of event that occurred. Possible values include: Error (Default) Warning
